name: portfolio-monorepo
author: Portfolio
//overrides: React runtime is 19.2.x. These overrides force a SINGLE @types/react identity across the tree: without them npm can hoist a second copy (@testing-library/react accepts ^18||^19), and two React type identities produce bogus TS2786 'cannot be used as a JSX component' and ReactNode-not-assignable-to-ReactNode errors even when the code is correct. NOTE: frontend-ci.yml also runs a nested `npm install` inside portfolio-ui, where these root overrides do NOT apply — that case is covered independently because portfolio-ui/package.json declares the same versions itself. Keep both in step.
